name: PayOnce check_payee
description: Verification of Payee for AI agents on Concordium testnet. Before an agent pays, ask who the account really is: MATCH (pay once), CLOSE_MATCH (a person decides), NO_MATCH (pay nothing) or UNVERIFIED (verification not possible: a person decides). Reads any x402 seller's payTo for free. Testnet names are self-asserted mock identities; the chain does not verify the ZK proof, a keyless verifier does.

interfaces.note: Send a data part {payee, name, network?} or the invoice text. The reply is one agent message: advice text plus the full check result. Free, read-only, nothing is paid.
stdio bridge to the hosted /mcp; source in packages/payonce-mcp
Pay-per-check: 402, pay with the standard x402 v2 exact scheme (native CCD, fee sponsored), then the verdict.

skills.name: Check a payee before paying
skills.description: Compare the name an invoice or instruction gave with the proven legal name of the account that would be paid.
examples: Check 3okVZT… as Acme ApS before paying

skills.name: Check an x402 seller without paying
skills.description: Read the seller's 402, then run check_payee on its payTo.

skills.name: Public payee card
skills.description: The proven name, bound status and hold of a Concordium account (the /p/<account> link).

rules.match: pay once, to this account only
rules.note: An agent pays only the account whose proven name matches.
